notes: True homograph of H7788 (שׁוּר, "journey") -- same bare consonants שור once the sin/shin dot (a diacritic, not a separate letter) is stripped, genuinely unrelated meanings. Both are new in this same batch, so neither needs a retroactive rename: assigned שור¹ (lower Strong's number) and שור² per the ascending-Strong's-number superscript convention. Two more unadded homonyms share these same consonants -- H7787 (שׂוּר, "saw, cut") and H7789 (שׁוּר, "spy, lurk, observe") -- flagged for whoever adds either of them next.

Requested Hiphil "make princes" is not attested under H7786 -- its only 2 occurrences are both Qal. That sense already lives in this dataset under the related-but-distinct H8323 שָׂרַר ("rule"; hiphil stem_gloss "appoint princes", cited to the same Hos.8.4 הֵשִׂ֖ירוּ), a geminate root, not a spelling variant of this hollow root -- kept as a separate root per an explicit decision, not merged in via strong_alt.

The qal wayyiqtol/3ms slot has a second attestation, Hos.12.5 (וָיָּשַׂר, with an unusual initial qamats where a patach is expected), immediately after the naming-pun verse Hos.12.4 (שָׂרָה, H8280) -- kept out of consideration as the representative citation in favor of Judg.9.22's clean, uncontested "reigned," though both independently support "rule."

H7787 (שׂוּר, "cut" -- the fourth homonym flagged in this root's notes above) has now been added, as שור³. H7789 ("spy, lurk, observe") remains unadded and will need the next available superscript when it is.
